title: Task id reservation and lock race hardening
description: Harden the single task id reservation, opener write, and lock promotion path to avoid duplicate IDs and stale reservation-only locks.
acceptance: Explicit-id and next-id allocation share the task-id-guard fence and reservation lock path
task-card-opener promotes successful writes through LockAdapter.lock() and releases current reservations on failure
task-lock.js is a thin CLI wrapper with no legacy duplicate implementation
Human override, task-card-path lookup, and reservation promotion have regression coverage
deliverables: LockAdapter promotion and human override fix
